description: This file defines configuration functions for Vitest testing environment specific to the Mattermost extension, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration, with a default export for the finalized configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
